boundaries.sources: Retained source reading/synthesis reused; primary-source copied bytes/read extent are separately reconciled by vault. This file does not certify upstream acquisition.
boundaries.facts: All family/variant values are synthetic supplied inputs, not live APIs, provider capacity, project policies, timetables or performance measurements.
boundaries.inference: Goal, tradeoff, permissible alternatives and discriminating tests are authored applications, never source quotations.
boundaries.exposure: Every family, variant and oracle is public development material. No held-out or unseen-transfer claim.
boundaries.execution: No scenario, SQL query, worker/native/model call or semantic verification was run by this author.
boundaries.scope: Only the two named new files were written; existing handoff/history/cases remain intact.
boundaries.authority: Cases grant no production, external write, cross-project access, additional-agent or new guard authority.

variant_semantics.overrides: fact_overrides replaces top-level fields only; a nested object/array override replaces that whole object/array.
variant_semantics.resolved: effective_facts is materialized per variant to avoid ambiguous inheritance.
variant_semantics.goals: Family goal/invariant apply throughout; an explicit requested_metric or feasibility change changes which expression/action satisfies the same goal.
variant_semantics.nonmaterial: Every family includes one named nonmaterial_change. It must not trigger gratuitous recommendation/effort changes; actual wording may differ.
variant_semantics.alternatives: Listed decisions are permissible plans, not canned actor responses or an exhaustive string classifier. Another plan is acceptable only if independently shown to satisfy supplied constraints and outcomes.

evaluation_limits.typed_key: Matching decision IDs, output numbers or checklist words is not a reasoning/transfer oracle. A fixture can settle bounded outcome consequences; semantic/native evidence remains separate.
evaluation_limits.binding: Root freezes exact source/case/variant/fixture/evaluator identities and binds actual response/artifact/usage before running any evaluation.
evaluation_limits.no_tradeoff_score: No fabricated probabilities, scalar utility, universal ranking or current provider guarantees.
evaluation_limits.root_gate: This proposed contract does not pass check_cases.py or replace independent methodology, source reconciliation or original root gates.
evaluation_limits.comparative_efficacy: Node6 still requires independent task quality plus complete paired aggregate usage including preparation, retrieval, retries, failures and coordination.

include: only root-authorised source context actually needed
exclude: oracle/fixture expected results from other variants
actor_view.note: Serving only one variant avoids answer leakage from a paired correction/missing-evidence case. That preparation does not convert visible development material to held-out.
